content: Finding Nobel Prize winners whose last name rhymes with their first name is a unique challenge. As of my knowledge cutoff in 2023, there are no Nobel Prize winners whose first and last names rhyme. The Nobel Prize has been awarded to individuals across various fields including Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature, Peace, and Economic Sciences, but none of the laureates have names that fit this specific criterion.
